canonical_project: ELIDZ Data Centre (Tier 3, Sunnyridge primary zone)
owner: East London Industrial Development Zone (ELIDZ) SOC Ltd

location.subnational: Eastern Cape - Buffalo City Metropolitan Municipality

notes: ELIDZ official release (27 Mar 2024) states the zone operates a data centre facility and, on high demand, was completing a new state-of-the-art Tier 3 data centre expanded in phases, offering colocation, disaster recovery and cloud services; zone has a 40MW grid supply and blown-fibre ring. EngineerIT confirms Workonline's first edge data centre PoP inside the ELIDZ secure primary zone at Sunnyridge, East London; ELIDZ tendered 'Construction of a Data Centre Facility / Meet-Me Room in Zone 1A' (closing Nov 2022). No public MW for the DC itself; 40MW refers to zone grid capacity, kept separate.
